hero_title: Theory of the Universe of Immaterial and Dimensionless Geometry
hero_lead: The Theory of the Universe of Immaterial and Dimensionless Geometry proposes an eternal, immobile cosmos whose apparent matter, motion, and time emerge from infinite geometric relationships.
builder_title:
Build a Meron.
See the geometry connect.
builder_body: The Meronic Builder visualizes how Compalphas, connected through Interaction Circles, construct Metalpha Merons and progressively more complex Meronic (atomic) structures.
premise_body: TUIDG begins with a radical proposition: reality is not built from indivisible corpuscles. It is an absolute void — the Omega Dimension — structured by immaterial geometric components and their logical, static relationships.
foundation_title: Four principles restrict what reality can be.
foundation_lead: Not assumptions about particles, but tests of logical possibility.

principles.title: Void–Matter Indistinction
principles.body: No absolute boundary can distinguish being from non-being.

principles.title: Indefinite Fragmentation
principles.body: Every supposedly minimal element implies an internal intermediate element.

principles.title: Constructive Interaction
principles.body: Separated elements cannot interact without a directly connected third element.

principles.title: Indefinite Containment
principles.body: Every proposed maximum volume implies a greater containing volume.

path_title: Explore the theory in a logical sequence.
path_lead: Six chapters lead from the foundational element to infinite apparent realities.

chapters.title: Fundamental Elements
chapters.body: Meet the Compalphas — immaterial, dimensionless geometric components proposed as the logical foundation of apparent matter.

chapters.title: Axiomatic Principles
chapters.body: Four restrictive principles define what can logically exist, fragment, interact, and contain.

chapters.title: Rotating Interaction
chapters.body: Interaction Circles connect the static geometry of Compalphas and construct increasingly complex Meronic structures.

chapters.title: Cyclic Interaction
chapters.body: A second geometric relationship describes oscillation, apparent motion, and electromagnetic phenomena.

chapters.title: The Merons
chapters.body: From Metalpha to the diversity of atoms: explore the structures that compose molecules and bodies.

chapters.title: Infinite Hexa-levels
chapters.body: Follow the theory from Geometric Continua to Hypercontinua and the infinite hierarchy of apparent realities.

author_body: The theoretical content, animations, and illustrations were created by Erisberto Saraiva Félix, a self-taught researcher in physics and philosophy. The theory was first conceived in 1986–1987, formally expressed in 2001, and published online in 2005.
